text:
Zoe: Quick sync — want to finalize form signal defaults across Console. Three decisions: where to show errors (inline vs top list), how to mark required fields, and standard for delete confirmations (undo vs typed confirm). Keep replies short.

Ravi: Inline for most field-level issues. Use top error list only when submit returns multiple server-side errors or for very long forms (>7 fields).

Maya: For validation timing: format checks on blur, presence/required on submit. Inline messages should be concise and show an example (e.g., ‘must be a valid email’).

Sam: Accessibility: asterisk must not be the only signal. If we show '*', include an offscreen 'Required' and set aria-required on the input. Also don’t use color alone.

Olivia: UI compromise: in dense lists hide the visible 'Required' label to reduce clutter; always keep the sr-only text so screen readers get it.

Ravi: Deletion rules: single-item -> soft delete + undo snackbar. Bulk -> show count and scope in snackbar and allow undo. Irreversible/permanent -> typed confirm with exact resource name.

Maya: Edge case: network lag can make the snackbar disappear. Ensure Trash and activity feed keep a recoverable copy for at least 30 days. Don’t rely solely on undo.

Sam: Quick a11y checklist to include in the doc: inline errors use aria-invalid + role="alert"; top summary uses role="alert" and anchor links that focus fields; required uses aria-required + sr-only; typed confirm must clearly communicate permanence.

Zoe: Decision summary: default inline (on-blur/submit), top summary for >7 fields or multi-field server errors, '*' + sr-only Required by default, soft delete + undo for item-level, typed confirm for permanent ops. I'll create a pattern doc and link code snippets.

design-bot: Created task "forms/patterns/validation-and-delete" -> /design-system/issues/578.

Ravi: I'll draft examples and post by Thursday.

Olivia: I'll add SR snippets and microcopy options.
